t: You're standing in front of the statue of Sarah Siddons, on Paddington Green near the Harrow Road. It is a marble sculpture by the French artist Léon-Joseph Chavalliaud, unveiled by the actor Henry Irving on 14 June 1897. Siddons was the leading tragedienne of her day, and she is buried in the nearby St Mary's Church. Her pose follows Joshua Reynolds's portrait of her as the Tragic Muse. The statue is Grade II listed. Sybil Thorndike led a campaign to restore it in 1952, and it was restored again in 2019.
